----------------
---- VIEWS
----------------


CREATE VIEW revenue_view
AS
SELECT 
      * 
FROM 
     OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'revenue',
        DATA_SOURCE= 'raw_ext_source1',
        FORMAT= 'CSV',
        PARSER_VERSION = '2.0',
        HEADER_ROW= TRUE
     ) as query1

SELECT * FROM revenue_view

SELECT * FROM revenue_cetas
